title: Open support tickets
definition: Current original-tenant tickets in open or waiting_customer, grouped by category, priority or current status. Resolved, closed, spam and duplicate tickets are excluded. No historical status is inferred from the current row.
limitations: Current snapshot only; previous comparison and historical snapshots are unavailable. Test/demo/internal workspaces are excluded through classification. An installed empty ticket source is a measured zero current count.

title: Support resolution feedback
definition: Yes responses / valid yes-or-no responses from the original ticket creator to a new observed human-supported resolution. One immutable answer per resolution episode. Cohorts use offer time; only responses observed before the half-open interval end count. Response rate is valid responses / observed in-app resolution offers in that cohort, including unanswered offers.
limitations: Only forward-collected resolution offers and optional qualified responses. No backfill, no AI acknowledgement and no overall customer satisfaction inference. Reopening disables an unanswered older offer; a new resolution can offer again. Empty source or zero responses never becomes a zero satisfaction ratio. Response rate denominator is observed offers, not a delivery/read acknowledgement.
